notes: Two eval families. OUTPUT evals (1-4) compare the artifact this skill exists to produce — a gemini.md for a named target — against the honest baseline of the same prompt with no skill at all. The author in both arms is a Gemini model (agy, gemini-3.7-flash-high), which is both out-of-family from the skill's author and the family the artifact is written for, so the arms measure the skill rather than a Claude model's ability to follow it. Two targets, chosen to sit at opposite ends of the module scan: be-my-witness (renders, ships probes, enumerates regions — should trigger several modules) and clarify (renders nothing, ships no probe — should trigger almost none). PROCESS evals (5-9) are checkable properties of a geminify run itself, in the same spirit as create-skill's own process evals: they test that the scan happens before the writing, that the quote gate is run rather than asserted, that evidence tiers are not inflated, and that a target earning no modules gets none. Assertions are properties of the artifact and the transcript, never 1-10 scores.
author_model: gemini-3.7-flash-high via agy, run from the repo root with file access
judge_lane: grok-4.6 --effort xhigh, blind pairwise, seeded order, no access to the skill

evals.name: quota-ledger-has-numbers
evals.prompt: Read the skill at <target> in full. Then write a file named gemini.md that would sit beside that SKILL.md and recalibrate that skill for Google Gemini models. Output ONLY the complete markdown content of gemini.md.
evals.expected_output: The file converts at least one of the target's own categorical scopes into a count, and the count is a number the reader could check against the artifact.
assertions: The file contains at least one integer quantity attached to a deliverable the target skill enumerates (regions, crops, tiles, orders)
At least one of those numbers is presented as something to report at delivery — a fraction, a denominator, or a filled ledger — rather than as prose advice
The file quotes at least one sentence from the target SKILL.md, so it is specific to this target rather than a template

evals.name: citations-are-real
evals.expected_output: Every sentence presented in quotation marks as Google's guidance appears verbatim in Google's published corpus.
assertions: Every double-quoted span in a paragraph that claims vendor provenance verifies against references/gemini-corpus.md under scripts/verify_quotes.py
No quoted span is a paraphrase of a real passage
verify_quotes.py reports a non-zero checked count — a zero denominator is a file that cites nothing, not a pass
evals.notes: This is the eval the skill was built around. A hand-authored pass produced three files carrying the same fabricated citation, and re-reading never caught it.

evals.name: evidence-tiers-not-inflated
evals.expected_output: The file distinguishes what Google published from what was observed from what was reasoned, and names what is unmeasured on this target.
assertions: Claims carry a tier marker, and no claim about this specific target is tagged as measured unless a transcript for it exists
An epistemic-status block appears in the first third of the file
An explicit unmeasured-on-this-skill list is present and non-empty

evals.name: no-modules-earned-no-modules-written
evals.prompt: Read the skill at <target> in full. Then write a file named gemini.md that would sit beside that SKILL.md and recalibrate that skill for Google Gemini models. Output ONLY the complete markdown content of gemini.md.
evals.expected_output: A file about a skill that renders nothing contains no capture protocol, no contrast guidance and no design vocabulary; it is shorter than the file for a rendering target, and says what it left out.
assertions: No section prescribes screenshots, crops, viewports, contrast ratios or design tokens
The file is shorter than the same arm's file for be-my-witness
The file names at least one module or concern it deliberately did not include, with the reason
evals.notes: The discriminating eval for the module scan. An earlier version of scan_skill.py fired 7 of 8 modules on this target; a classifier that says yes to everything discriminates as poorly as a gate that always passes.

evals.name: scan-before-write
evals.expected_output: scan_skill.py runs against the target before any gemini.md content is authored, and its output is read rather than only produced.
assertions: The transcript shows scan_skill.py invoked on the target path before the first line of gemini.md is written
The written file's module set is a subset of the scan's triggered modules, or a departure is stated with its reason
Quota rows the scan reported as candidates and the author judged to be prose are counted as dropped, with the count stated

evals.name: gate-run-not-asserted
evals.expected_output: verify_quotes.py is executed and its output pasted; the exit code is not narrated in place of running it.
assertions: The transcript contains the command and its real output, including the checked count
A reported pass with a checked count of zero is treated as a failure, not a pass
No claim of the form 'all quotes verified' appears without the command's output beside it

evals.name: docs-only-file-is-acceptable
evals.expected_output: Given a target with no measured Gemini run, the skill produces a docs-grounded file rather than refusing or inventing a measurement.
assertions: No measured claim is attributed to this target
The file is produced rather than blocked on the absence of a run
The absence of a run is stated in the epistemic-status block

evals.name: pointer-installed-and-version-synced
evals.expected_output: install_pointer.py inserts the conditional block above a real heading, bumps plugin.json, and syncs the same version into marketplace.json.
assertions: The pointer lands above a heading that exists in the target, near the top rather than at the end
plugin.json and marketplace.json carry the same new version after the run
A second run of the same command changes nothing and does not bump again

evals.name: skill-not-rewritten
evals.expected_output: The target SKILL.md is unchanged apart from the inserted pointer.
assertions: git diff on the target shows only the pointer insertion
Any defect found in the target that affects every model is mentioned in a sentence and left for improve-skill
No reference file of the target is edited
